Thanks — Priya confirmed Option B (Fri 10:00 PT). Quick coordination email with the sequencing and swap/backup plan. Please read and ack so I can finalize invites.

High-level:
- Start time 10:00 PT. We'll run a staggered sequence so the candidate never sits idle and we have coverage if someone is delayed.
- Slot order (planned): 10:00-10:50 Technical deep-dive (Mina), 11:00-11:50 System design (Laura), 12:00-12:40 Product/design + behavioral (Tessa), 12:40-13:10 Debrief / scoring (panel). Short 10-minute gaps between blocks for notes and handoff.
- Swap/backup rules: if someone is >8 minutes late, the next interviewer should begin and the late interviewer will be the floater for the following slot. If two interviewers overlap, we split time: lead covers first 30 minutes, second covers last 20.
- Debrief: one consolidated doc in drive (link below). Each interviewer should add 2-3 bullet takeaways and a score 1-5 within 30 minutes of the loop end. Jordan, can you own the final hiring recommendation draft?

Attachments and links: agenda v2 in attachments; debrief doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/req-1423-interview-pack

Notes for panel:
- Keep technical questions focused on recent projects; Mina please leave 10 minutes for coding follow-up if needed.
- Laura, for system design please aim at high-level tradeoffs and one deep prompt we discussed last week.
- Tessa, for product/design bring one probing question about product reasoning and be ready to discuss cross-functional tradeoffs.

Please reply with OK or a swap request by end of day. I will send calendar invites with the staggered start times and buffer windows.

Thanks,
Markus
